Why do some people never meet someone they dislike?

Kevin Trudeau tells the story of Will Rogers, the famous cowboy known for saying he never met a person he didn't like. Kevin contrasts that with people who keep pointing the finger at one "toxic" person after another.

His idea is that the people we keep meeting may have something to do with what we are attracting into our lives.

When did you last ask what a pattern in your relationships might be telling you?
